name: Daniel Durant
bio: Daniel Durant is an American stage and screen actor. He is a member of the Deaf community. He is best known for portraying Moritz Stiefel in the 2015 Broadway Revival of Spring Awakening, and for his recurring role as Matthew on the television series Switched at Birth.

credits.title: Being Heumann
credits.overview: Scrappy, defiant, and done being treated like a burden, Judy Heumann turns her outrage into a revolution. In 1977, she and more than 100 disability rights protestors send a very loud message: The system is broken—not us.

credits.title: Silent Notes
credits.overview: After finding out he is going deaf, Bruce is stuck at a crossroads: he needs a surgical intervention that he can’t afford. credits.title: Millstone
credits.overview: Featuring an entirely deaf cast and shot exclusively in American Sign Language, this is the story of a desperate, grieving couple who think they have found the only therapist who can help them - but his methods might be worse than anyone imagined.

credits.title: CODA
credits.overview: As a CODA (Child of Deaf Adults), Ruby is the only hearing person in her deaf family. When the family's fishing business is threatened, Ruby finds herself torn between pursuing her love of music and her fear of abandoning her parents.
